drhp.business: Shubhshree converts agricultural waste into biomass pellets and briquettes that serve as a substitute for coal, catering to power plants, large industries and MNCs across multiple states. It operates a fully integrated farm-to-factory model covering raw material sourcing, processing and delivery, and operates in a single reportable segment comprising the manufacturing and trading of biomass fuels.

risks.note: Dependence on agricultural residues and biomass feedstock, which may be affected by seasonal variations, climatic conditions and crop patterns.
Fluctuations in biomass procurement, transportation and other input costs may impact profitability and margins.
Changes in government policies, environmental regulations and renewable energy frameworks may influence industry growth and business operations.
Disruptions in sourcing, storage, transportation or logistics infrastructure may affect operational efficiency and timely deliveries.
Increasing competition from organized and unorganized players, as well as alternative fuel sources, may exert pressure on pricing and margins.
Any slowdown in industrial activity or reduction in energy consumption by end-user industries may impact demand for biomass fuels.
Delays in customer payments or deterioration in the financial position of counterparties may affect cash flows and working capital management.
Adverse weather conditions and environmental factors may impact biomass availability and procurement activities.

sk.overview: Per the CRISIL report commissioned and paid for by the issuer, the industry spans three linked value chains serving India's steel and heavy-engineering base. Metal rolls are the consumable working element of rolling mills — cast or forged in alloy steel, spheroidal graphite iron, high-chrome iron, adamite, graphite steel, indefinite-chill or tungsten carbide — which shape billets, blooms and slabs into finished long and flat steel; because they wear continuously, they are replaced on average every 5-10 weeks, making demand a consumable annuity that CRISIL describes as 'perfectly and …
